description: This file contains FastAPI test cases using pytest and the FastAPI TestClient. It performs validation testing for query parameter constraints such as minimum and maximum length, as well as checking the OpenAPI schema output.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a module based on the request parameter, creates a FastAPI TestClient instance, and returns it for testing.

methods.name: test_query_params_str_validations_no_query(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that a GET request without query parameters returns a successful response with expected default items.

methods.name: test_query_params_str_validations_q_query(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that a GET request with a valid 'q' query parameter returns expected items including the 'q' parameter in the response.

methods.name: test_query_params_str_validations_q_too_short(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that a GET request with a 'q' query parameter shorter than the minimum length returns a 422 validation error with appropriate message.

methods.name: test_query_params_str_validations_q_too_long(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that a GET request with a 'q' query parameter longer than the maximum length returns a 422 validation error with appropriate message.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Validates that the OpenAPI schema generated by the FastAPI app correctly includes the 'q' query parameter constraints and response schemas.
